description: Call this when the buyer picks, compares or asks about a home find_homes returned, before answering about its schools, childcare, who lives nearby, safety, development or sales nearby: find_homes gives only what each home matched. Pass the same answers and the home's id. Returns its facts, school zones and nearest schools, childcare in its suburb, who lives nearby, recorded crime, development applications nearby and recent sales nearby.

id.description: The id of a home find_homes returned for the same answers.

suburbs.description: Suburbs the home must be in, each spelled exactly as find_suburb returns it. Empty or left out means anywhere in Sydney. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

development.description: Set to avoid homes with a major project (over $5m) within 500 m. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

zoning.description: The kind of area the home's own lot must be zoned for. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

arriveBy.description: The time to arrive by, 24-hour "HH:MM". Needed for the public transport trip to be checked. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

days.description: The days the trip is made. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

destination.description: Where the buyer travels to, as find_place labels it. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

destinationBasis.description: Set to "lookup" when the position came from find_place. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

destinationLat.description: The latitude of the place find_place returned. Never guess one: without find_place, leave out the whole commute. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

destinationLng.description: The longitude of the place find_place returned. Never guess one: without find_place, leave out the whole commute. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

maxMinutes.description: The longest the trip may take, in minutes. Only a public transport ("Transit") trip rules homes out. Needed for the public transport trip to be checked. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

mode.description: How the buyer travels. A driving or cycling trip is not checked here and rules nothing out. Needed for the public transport trip to be checked. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

childcare.description: Kinds of childcare the home's suburb must have. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

arts.description: Arts places the buyer likes. Shown on Sagashi's map in the app; it changes no verdict here. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

cuisines.description: Kinds of restaurant the buyer likes. Shown on Sagashi's map in the app; it changes no verdict here. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

outdoors.description: Outdoor places the buyer likes. Shown on Sagashi's map in the app; it changes no verdict here. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

sport.description: Places for sport the buyer likes. Shown on Sagashi's map in the app; it changes no verdict here. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

baths.description: The fewest bathrooms that fit. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

beds.description: The fewest bedrooms that fit. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

budget.description: The price range in THOUSANDS of dollars: $1.2m is 1200. Give min, max or both; a missing bound means no limit. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

cars.description: The fewest parking spaces that fit. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

types.description: Kinds of home that fit. Set it whenever the buyer names one: "a house" is ["House"], "a unit" or "a flat" is ["Apartment"]. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

stages.description: Which stages of school the nearest Catholic and independent schools are shown for. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

travelTo.description: Kinds of school the buyer wants nearby. With schools.within set, a home with none that close is ruled out. Needs schools.within for the distance to be checked. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

within.description: How far, in a straight line, the nearest school of a kind in schools.travelTo may be. Needs schools.travelTo for the distance to be checked. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.

zoneSchools.description: Public schools whose zone the home must be in, as four-digit codes from find_school. Never a name. Leave it out unless the buyer said it.
